notes: TEST BUILD — PR #17's new commit, pushed to the updater at Michael's request. The anywhere-controls overlay is rebuilt as two windows: a small permanent handle, and a separate full-screen pie window created at its final position when you grab the handle — the old design morphed one window mid-gesture, which is what made Android cancel swipes and forced the workarounds. The handle forwards your gesture to the pie; a release before the pie's first frame just parks it. Selection following the fan, the rim baseline and the centre dead zone from the previous test build are all kept.
